```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

payload <- readRDS("results/fast-multinom.rds")
results <- payload$results
```

_Generated: `r format(payload$generated, tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE)`_

R `r payload$r_version`;
flexmix `r payload$pkg_flexmix`;
flexmix.extensions `r payload$pkg_extensions`.

Times are medians over 3 iterations. `speedup = ref / fast`.

## Results

```{r table}
results |>
  mutate(
    ref_s = signif(median_ref, 3),
    fast_s = signif(median_fast, 3),
    speedup = signif(speedup, 3)
  ) |>
  select(n, k, n_concomitant, ref_s, fast_s, speedup) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r plot}
ggplot(results, aes(n, speedup, color = factor(k))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~n_concomitant, labeller = label_both) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "n (obs)", y = "speedup (ref / fast)", color = "k") +
  theme_minimal()
```
